entry.title: Typewriter 0.1.39
entry.content: Typewriter 0.1.39: with the lock on, the phone's PIN screen comes up upright instead of squeezed sideways, and the screen turns back when you're done.

entry.title: Typewriter 0.1.38
entry.content: Typewriter 0.1.38: the diary can keep its own Diary folder, and a lock can ask for your phone's screen lock before the diary, or the whole app, opens.

entry.title: Bitcoin 0.1.12
entry.content: Bitcoin 0.1.12: no Blockstream servers for the blockchain, prices, chart or explorer: balances come from electrum.jhoenicke.de, with fulcrum.grey.pw as the backup, and prices, the price chart and View in explorer from mempool.space; two-factor (2of2) and 2of3 multisig wallets are gone; your hardware wallet's firmware is checked only when you ask for an update; Device info shows which PIN server your hardware wallet used, with a new help section about it; settings pages now look like the other apps' settings, with plain rows and a scrollbar in place of the page arrows.

entry.title: Typewriter 0.1.37
entry.content: Typewriter 0.1.37: new sheets saved as plain text, in a folder chosen through Cabinet, keep their .txt and show in the list again, as do ones already written that way.

entry.title: Remote 0.2.21
entry.content: Remote 0.2.21: after the phone is locked and unlocked, Remote registers with Bluetooth again by itself and reconnects to the computer it was driving, instead of failing to register until Bluetooth is turned off and on; a list whose rows arrive late opens on its first row

entry.title: Handheld Games 0.1.36
entry.content: Handheld Games 0.1.36: a settings page whose rows load a moment late (Settings → Advanced) no longer opens blank

entry.title: Bitcoin 0.1.10
entry.content: Bitcoin 0.1.10: the old wallet's names, logos and links are gone from every screen and language, and a hardware wallet is simply your hardware wallet; help points to this app's own help page; lists turn page by page on whole rows, with the row cut at the foot shown in long lists; links open in your chosen browser, or Android's chooser when you have several.

entry.title: Shelf 0.1.35
entry.content: Shelf 0.1.35: an older Norwegian book filed under its ISBN-10 alone is found in the Nasjonalbiblioteket; a book from Portugal is looked up in PORBASE; a book no catalog knows is asked of K10plus, the German union catalog, before Google Books
